pass_rule: Repository must be clean before running the training script.
Pair coverage, leakage guard, batch balance, rating-distance audit, micro-overfit, and shuffled-label negative control must pass.
Only fixed first-pass hyperparameters from the run matrix are used.
Outputs are diagnostic only and cannot support final LOSO or mainline claims.
failure_action: Do not update claims; require review closeout.

pass_rule: Every candidate maps to one mechanistic question from the design matrix.
A candidate is promising only with consistent task/fold gains, not one isolated fold.
failure_action: Treat as inconclusive; require confirmation or failure analysis.
